creatorThread.subject: almost done with the pump!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am wrapping up the repair job on the moisture pump at the junk market. My brass dish is tapping a steady beat while I tighten the final intake valve. Once I collect my pay, it is straight back to Hangar Bay 3 for more Little Dart work!

- Zeeb

- Zeeb
